title: CogniShiftRawBenchmarkResult
description: Schema for individual line-delimited raw execution records (JSONL) across all CogniShift benchmark suites.

item_id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluated benchmark item (e.g. FUNSD_001, CORD_TEST_042, CSB_Q012).

dataset_id.description: Canonical dataset identifier (e.g. funsd, cord_v2, nasa_ntrs, csb_reports, pointer_meter).

input_reference.description: Reference metadata for the benchmark stimulus (file path, query text, image path, etc.).

ground_truth.description: Ground truth payload (string, object, array, or numeric value) used for scoring.

prediction.description: Direct prediction or output generated by the CogniShift system under test.

metrics.description: Key-value mapping of evaluated metric scores for this item (e.g. cer, wer, recall_at_3, exact_match, mae).

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock execution latency for this item in milliseconds.

success.description: True if execution completed without uncaught exception or system abort.

model_name.description: Name of the local model evaluated (e.g. llama3.2:3b, moondream, bge-small-en-v1.5, rapidocr-ppocrv4).

provider.description: Inference backend (e.g. ollama, fastembed, onnxruntime, docker).

run_configuration.description: Execution parameters under test (operating_mode, temperature, top_k, chunk_size, timeout).
